# Nofakey.ai

> A free, privacy-first tool that checks WhatsApp messages, emails, and news
> text for common scam and misinformation wording patterns. Not a full
> fact-checking service — a fast first-pass filter, plus guides that help
> people verify claims themselves.

## Pages
- [Home](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/): Free spam & fake news checker
- [Blog](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog.html): Guides on spotting fake news and scams
- [About](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/about.html): What Nofakey.ai is and isn't
- [Contact](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/contact.html): Get in touch

## Blog posts
- [How to Check If a Loan Offer Message Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-loan-offer-message-is-a-scam.html): A text says you're pre-approved for an instant loan if you pay a small fee first? Here's how to tell a real loan offer from a scam.
- [How to Check If a Bank Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-bank-message-is-fake.html): Got a text saying your bank account will be blocked unless you 'update KYC' right now? Here's how to tell if a bank message is real or a scam.
- [How to Check If a Delivery Message Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-delivery-message-is-a-scam.html): A text says your parcel is stuck and needs a small fee to be released? Here's how to tell a real delivery notice from a scam before you pay anything.
- [How to Check If a Job Offer Message Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-job-offer-message-is-a-scam.html): Got an unexpected job offer on WhatsApp or email? Here's how to tell a real opportunity from a scam before you hand over any money or details.
- [How to Check If a Lottery or Prize Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-lottery-or-prize-message-is-fake.html): A message says you've won a lottery, gift card, or prize you don't remember entering? Here's how to tell if it's real before you respond.
- [How to Check If a WhatsApp Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-whatsapp-message-is-fake.html): A practical, no-jargon checklist for spotting fake WhatsApp forwards and scam messages before you share or act on them.
